findings.message: `saveOrder(order)` is not awaited, so the handler responds with 201 before the order is persisted. A failed save becomes an unhandled rejection, and the client is told an order exists that may never have been stored.

The express endpoint never checks for a signed-in user and never ties the new order to one. Anyone can create orders, and nothing records who owns them, so later ownership checks have nothing to compare against.

`req.body as Cart` is only a type assertion; the untrusted body is not validated. A malformed or tampered cart reaches `orderFromCart`, which can crash the handler or, if the cart carries client-supplied prices, produce manipulated totals.
